verdict: Paid leads flowing at industry-level cost, but call volume and website taps are thin for peak cooling season.
diagnosis: Instagram lead ads spent $7,834 for 54 leads at $145 each — near the non-branded HVAC benchmark, but with weak follow-through signals.

signals.headline: 54 leads at $145 each
signals.detail: Instagram Instant Form delivered 54 leads this period. Cost per lead sits close to the non-branded HVAC benchmark of $149.

signals.headline: Only 71 call clicks logged
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 71 calls and 96 direction requests in 28 days. Low for a contractor during peak cooling demand.

signals.headline: 12 new reviews, 5-star average
signals.detail: Reputation is a strength. 12 fresh reviews added, average rating holding at 5 stars across 218 total reviews.

signals.headline: 200,666 impressions, 1,886 clicks
signals.detail: Click rate landed near 0.9 percent. Below what social HVAC creative should pull when the offer is a free bid.

signals.headline: Zero tracked purchases or bookings
signals.detail: No pixel purchases, business bookings, or food orders recorded. Downstream conversion tracking is missing or broken.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: SearchLight's 2026 HVAC benchmark pegs blended Google Ads cost per lead at $104, with non-branded search at $149. Your $145 Instagram lead cost sits inside that range.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Peak cooling season inflates lead costs
seasonal.body: Industry sources confirm HVAC click and lead costs rise during peak cooling months as more advertisers bid on emergency demand. Magnitude varies by climate and local competition.

competitor.label: Category
competitor.subheader: Local Services Ads win on cost
competitor.body: Google Local Services Ads average $53 per home services lead in 2026, with HVAC book rates near 44 percent. Most competitors now treat LSAs as the primary paid channel.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads as primary paid channel
recommendations.detail: Competitors are booking leads at roughly $53 through LSAs versus your $145 on Instagram. Worth exploring given your 5-star rating already qualifies you for strong placement.

recommendations.title: Fix conversion tracking before scaling spend
recommendations.detail: Zero pixel purchases and zero bookings recorded this period. Consider auditing pixel events and call tracking so you can tell which leads become paying jobs.

recommendations.title: Push new reviews to Google Business Profile weekly
recommendations.detail: 12 reviews in 28 days is solid. Test a post-job text ask to keep velocity up — review recency is now a local ranking signal.
